_note: Display copy for the two matches. These values are fixed content, not generated: scripts/check_match_copy.py verifies every name, minute, score and count against data/raw and exits 1 on a mismatch. Finding goals and buildups in the data is the EventFeed module's job, not this file's. Nothing in app/web reads this yet; the screens still carry their copy inline, and wiring them to it is Phase 5. The list is pre-match: kickoff time and 0-0, no clock and no GPS badge. Anything later in the match belongs to the screens that come after selection. One session clock runs through every screen: it sits at the hero moment, and nothing after it is shown anywhere.
